name: How does foreclosed property flooring installation usually work?

mainEntity.name: How does foreclosed property flooring installation usually work?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually starts with an estimate, then removal of damaged flooring, inspection of the subfloor, repairs if needed, and installation of the new material. For foreclosed homes in the Denver metro area, the biggest variable is often what gets discovered after demolition begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: It usually goes estimate, removal, subfloor inspection, repairs, then installation. Foreclosed homes often reveal hidden issues after the old flooring is removed.
